answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 5389 Country: Bangladesh Title: What is the exact timings of Ishraq prayers (start and last time)? When does the Ishraq's time start after sunrise? Some people say, the Ishraq timings start after 23 minutes of sunrise and some say after 15 or 10 minutes. Plz Tell me the exact time. Question: Assalamu Alikum What is the exact timings of Ishraq prayers (start and last time)? When does the Ishraq's time start after sunrise? Some people say, the Ishraq timings start after 23 minutes of sunrise and some say after 15 or 10 minutes. Plz Tell me the exact time. With Regards! Answer ID: 5389 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 712/661=D-1429) The time of ishraq begins after 12-15 minutes from sunrise and remains till one fourth of the day. Afterwards, the time of chasht ( صلاۃ الضحی ) starts and remains till exact midday. The time of ishraq starts 12-15 after sunrise and remains till one fourth of the day. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
